title: Battle of Eckernförde
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Eckernförde", at revision 1370439713, opens: "The Battle of Eckernförde was a Danish naval assault on Schleswig. The Danes were defeated and two of their ships were lost, with the surviving crew being detained." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q479762, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1849 battle near Eckernförde, Germany". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
regionNote: Lane written by the Wikidata import (derived from its own point): this event points at no place record, so the timeline has nothing else to go on.
